verdict.rationale: Pipeline CRM publishes a REST API reference with an interactive Test Request console. Probes confirmed an API-focused llms.txt covering deals, people, companies, activities, calendar entries and documents, plus a live openapi.json spec, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on reports of using the API end to end, and evidence on auth, scopes and rate limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
